Privacy notice

Practice data stays in your browser. This app stores answers, review marks, selected topics and difficulty, question order and position, theme, Focus preference, border design, selected font, interface scale, and question text size in local storage under sat-room-v1. It does not send that practice record to an app database or sync it between devices. A question ID may appear in the page URL; sharing that URL shares the ID, not your saved answers.

The current application includes no advertising, marketing cookies, analytics scripts, account-registration form, or payment form. Essential browser storage supports the requested practice features. The hosting and access providers may process IP addresses, request URLs, browser information, access credentials, and security logs to deliver and protect the service. Their processing is governed by their own policies, including OpenAI’s privacy policy. The operator cannot promise that infrastructure logs do not exist or specify a retention period controlled by the host.

Custom font files you select are stored separately in this browser’s IndexedDB database sat-room-fonts-v1 and loaded locally using the browser font engine. They are not uploaded to the operator. You are responsible for having permission to use them. You can select a built-in fallback or delete individual fonts in Settings.

Optional Desmos calculator: Opening Calculator loads the College Board testing calculator directly from Desmos in an embedded window. Your browser connects to Desmos, which may process network information, calculator input, and browser storage under Desmos’s privacy policy. The calculator requires an internet connection. Closing the window preserves its calculations for this page session; reloading the page clears this embedded session.

Your controls: Settings → Reset practice progress clears answers and review marks. Settings → Delete all saved site data removes all app preferences, progress, and custom font files on this browser. You can also clear this site’s storage through your browser. Records remain locally until removed, overwritten, or cleared by the browser. These controls do not delete hosting-provider logs or emails you have sent. Do not enter sensitive personal information in answer fields.

Contact and external services: If you email the operator, your address and message are processed to respond and handle the issue. Messages may be retained while needed for support, security, or legal obligations; request deletion through the contact below, subject to lawful retention. Links to College Board, GitHub, and Ko-fi lead to independent services. They receive connection information when opened and apply their own privacy and payment terms. This site does not receive your card details. It does not sell practice records or use them for targeted advertising.

Children and regional rights: This service is intended for high-school students and other users aged 13 or older; it is not directed to children under 13. Do not send personal information about a child under 13. A parent or guardian can contact the operator about suspected collection. Depending on your location and the applicable law, you may have rights to access, correct, delete, restrict, or object to processing of personal information, or complain to a privacy regulator. Contact the operator to make a request; local practice data can be deleted directly as described above. No date of birth or identification document is requested by this app.

Accessibility

The interface supports keyboard controls, visible focus indicators, labeled controls, dialog navigation with Escape to close, browser zoom, light and dark themes, and reduced-motion preferences. Question text size is adjustable from 12 to 36 px (default 18 px), and saved or built-in fonts can be selected in Settings. Split question panes scroll independently and can receive keyboard focus. Focus hides the site header while retaining practice controls; Unfocus or Escape returns to the regular layout. We use WCAG 2.2 Level AA as a technical improvement target, including keyboard access, visible focus, reflow, and touch targets. Topic and subject reset controls work with keyboard activation; confirmation is shown unless Shift is held while clicking. Resetting selected topics affects all difficulties, including questions hidden by review filters. These features are not a certification of compliance. Third-party question graphics, mathematical notation, and long passages may have accessibility limitations. For an accessible alternative or to report an accessibility barrier, email yapperyapemail@proton.me. Include the page URL, question ID, browser, assistive technology if relevant, and the action you were trying to complete. You can also use official Bluebook practice.
